vetSays.line: 🛡️ Tom, Salvatore, Shannon and Sigrun met them at the door — 3 put down, 1 driven off. Tom, Shannon, Sigrun are hurt.
🛡️ Salvatore, Shannon, Shreya and Fatima met them at the door — 3 put down, 1 barely walked away. Salvatore, Shannon, Shreya, Fatima are hurt.

📺 "Oh, you survived the AUDIENCE NOTES? Cute. We've stopped pretending these are animals now. That was the FINAL DRAFT, folks — what comes out of the treeline next was never alive the way you mean it."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Desmond just put down Ad Break... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Salvatore, Shannon, Shreya and Sigrun met them at the door — 3 put down, 1 driven off. Salvatore, Shannon, Shreya, Sigrun are hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Valeria just put down The Callback... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Shreya just put down The Terms of Service... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 "We've been watching you for a LONG time. Your faiths. Your formats. Your little institutions. So we built something out of... well. Out of YOU. Say hello to the MIRROR DRAFT."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Shreya just put down Loud-Eyes... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."

◈ SYSTEM: "Four waves. FOUR. The producers are — okay, I'm saying it: FINALES need a NATION. You've got a region; now make it a REALM. Bind fires under one head, or bend the knee to someone who has. The higher-ups are watching. ...Did I say higher-ups? I said NOTHING. Forget the higher-ups."

◈ ARC IV — THE INEFFICIENCY. SYSTEM: "ROUNDING ERROR RECLASSIFIED: ANOMALY. Organic consumption yields impossible output. Recalculating. Recalculating." — They finally see it. The thing they laughed at — needing to EAT — is the engine. Their confusion is your weapon now. You stood up to the calibration fauna, the audience's notes, the Final Draft — lived through their Show, weathered the worst together, and built something bigger than a village. One day humanity will need a case to make. The case is made of deeds, not words — and yours, though unfinished, are undeniable. (Feasted buffs burn ho
📺 "But finales — FINALES need a LEGEND, sweetheart. More STANDING — blood, bonds, or bread — and look the Mirror Draft in the eye. The producers are WAITING."
⚠ This one is different — bigger, and it didn't come alone. A Pack-leader veteran.

⚠️ Two threats: Pack-leader The Big Beast (×2) and an eye-head (×6) — all here, all now.
Your party: Salvatore, Fatima, Chantal. You are outnumbered — fight like it.
Fatima strikes the Pack-leader The Big Beast.
Chantal strikes the Pack-leader The Big Beast.
The Pack-leader The Big Beast falls.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Fatima just put down The Big Beast... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Chantal just put down The Eater... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 "You've gotten too big for the story. Ratings are GREAT, by the way — but you're threatening the narrative now. So the narrative is fighting back. Meet the PRODUCERS."
Blooded — the village knows where the Producers bleed. (Strikes hit 1.5× as hard; their blows land at 0.75× strength.)
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Fatima just put down The Rerun... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
★ The record corrects itself: this was never Cush-cush Yam — it's Ground Elder. Chloe taught you wrong (their own memory). (The Codex marks the disagreement. You can call them out in conversation.)
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Chloe just put down The Suburb... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Maria just put down Ugly-Eyes... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Chantal just put down The Big Beast... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📻 The producers name it: the Nielsen. Ratings embodied. It fights boring — and the crowd adores it for that.
